console.emptyStore: No logs stored yet. Interact with the application or generate test logs from the toolbar.
console.emptyFiltered: No logs match the current filters.
console.correlationTooltip: Show every app and worker row for this request

page.title: Developer Console
page.exportIntro: Export database tables to JSON format for creating sample data files. Save exported files to /public/sample-data/ directory. To load sample data, navigate to ?loadSampleData when creating a new database.

settingsTab.title: Developer
settingsTab.description: Debug-only tools, visible because the app was opened with ?debug.
settingsTab.logsDescription: Structured logs from every tab and the database worker are kept in a separate, unencrypted browser store (ptbudgetapp-logs) and shown in the Developer Console.
settingsTab.untilEvicted: Until evicted by the entry cap
settingsTab.resetWarning: Deletes the database, all settings, and cookies, then reloads the app to its original, first-run state. This cannot be undone.
settingsTab.clearDialogBody: Every stored log entry from every tab and the database worker is deleted. Your financial data is not affected.
